parts.label: Part 4
parts.article:
I'm going to talk about a field trial that was carried out on heat pumps, but first, some background. The UK has adopted a very ambitious target for reducing carbon emissions. 27% of British carbon dioxide emissions come from the energy used in homes, so around a quarter of all reductions must also come from that sector rather than industry. So it's not surprising that the government, private companies and independent agencies have been looking into green energy alternatives. At present, the most popular green energy from a range which includes wind, biomass heating and ground heat is solar. This has been the most readily accepted by the public. However, the field trial I've looked at researched heat pump technology. Heat pump technology is relatively new to the UK market, and because there is such limited experience of this technology, people have been reluctant to invest in it, so a field trial was needed to monitor this in a sample of heat pumps in real situations.
The heat pumps in this trial are used for the same reason you'd use a boiler, but rather than burning a fuel to produce heat, they move heat from a low temperature heat source and pump it to a higher temperature where it can be used to provide central heating or domestic hot water. Most heat pumps take heat from either the ground or the air, but water from ponds or rivers may occasionally be used. The general advice in the UK is that the temperature of the hot water stored in a cylinder should be periodically put up to 60 degrees centigrade to kill off bacteria. It is sometimes necessary to use an electric immersion heater to achieve this temperature, as most heat pump installations will be designed to produce domestic hot water at temperatures between 50 and 55 degrees centigrade.
For this field trial, 83 UK sites were monitored, and they provided a wide spectrum of performance results, even in installations that seemed similar. Some installations performed as well as heat pumps studied in European field trials, but many failed to meet these levels. This field trial monitored two central heating systems, radiators and the increasingly popular under-floor systems.
The observations of the field trial led to some key conclusions. One was that heat pumps are sensitive pieces of equipment. In some of the early installations there were problems because the engineers hadn’t fitted the heat pump correctly. This observation emphasises the need for better training for everyone involved in the installation. Many different systems were monitored in the field trial, and it was found that in most cases designs which were simple were more efficient. So this is something which both pump manufacturers and installers should bear in mind.
Many customers mistakenly came to the conclusion that their system wasn’t working as well as they’d expected. However, when this was further investigated, it was found that they had not realized how to regulate the controls properly. There had been a failure to explain this in sufficient detail to the house holders. And it was often the case that for the installation all sorts of workmen might be involved. For example, a ground works contractor, a plumber, a heat pump installer and an electrician. It was obvious that a supervisor should be appointed to oversee and be responsible for the whole installation.
So what are the implications of this technology on a wider range?

analyses.content: 录音提到英国27%的碳排放来自“家庭”使用的能源，因此减排目标也主要针对这一领域。

The UK has adopted a very ambitious target for reducing carbon emissions. 27% of British carbon dioxide emissions come from the energy used in homes, so around a quarter of all reductions must also come from that sector rather than industry.
题目中的 "consumed in" 对应录音中的 "used in"，听到 "industry" 时不要填，因为录音说的是 "rather than industry"（而不是工业）。
At present, the most popular green energy from a range which includes wind, biomass heating and ground heat is solar. This has been the most readily accepted by the public.
录音中列举了 wind（风能）和 biomass（生物质能）作为干扰项，但它们只是备选范围，不是 "most popular" 的那个。
录音明确指出，在目前的绿色能源中，最受欢迎且公众接受度最高的是“太阳能”。

Heat pump technology is relatively new to the UK market, and because there is such limited experience of this technology, people have been reluctant to invest in it, so a field trial was needed to monitor this in a sample of heat pumps in real situations.
题目中的 "lack of" 对应录音中的 "limited"，你可能想填 technology，但这在题目中已经有了，缺的是 "experience"。
录音解释说，人们不愿投资是因为对这项技术只有非常有限的“经验”。

The heat pumps in this trial are used for the same reason you'd use a boiler, but rather than burning a fuel to produce heat, they move heat from a low temperature heat source and pump it to a higher temperature where it can be used to provide central heating or domestic hot water.
注意听到 "same reason" 时就要竖起耳朵，不要填成 fuel（燃料），那是锅炉燃烧的东西，不是设备本身。
录音中讲者通过类比，说使用热泵的原因和你使用“锅炉”的原因是一样的。
Most heat pumps take heat from either the ground or the air, but water from ponds or rivers may occasionally be used.
题目中的 "earth" 对应录音中的 "ground"，你需要填剩下的那个来源；不要填 water/ponds，录音说那只是 "occasionally"（偶尔）使用。
录音提到大多数热泵从地面（ground）或“空气”中获取热量。
录音指出将水温升至60摄氏度的目的是为了杀灭“细菌”。
The general advice in the UK is that the temperature of the hot water stored in a cylinder should be periodically put up to 60 degrees centigrade to kill off bacteria.
题目中的 "destroy" 对应录音中的 "kill off"；注意不要被后面的 50 或 55 degrees 干扰，那是普通热水的温度。
This field trial monitored two central heating systems, radiators and the increasingly popular under-floor systems.
听到 "two central heating systems" 后紧跟的就是答案，注意要填复数形式 radiators，因为录音中是复数且与 systems 对应。
试验监测了两种中央供暖系统：越来越流行的地暖系统以及“散热器”。

In some of the early installations there were problems because the engineers hadn’t fitted the heat pump correctly. This observation emphasises the need for better training for everyone involved in the installation.
题目中的 "improved" 对应录音中的 "better"；不要填 engineers，因为他们是需要被培训的对象。
录音提到早期安装出现问题，这强调了为所有参与安装的人员提供更好“培训”的必要性。

Many different systems were monitored in the field trial, and it was found that in most cases designs which were simple were more efficient. So this is something which both pump manufacturers and installers should bear in mind.
题目问什么样的 designs 表现最好（best = more efficient），不要被 efficient 这个词本身干扰而忽略了形容词 simple。
录音发现在大多数情况下，“简单的”设计反而效率更高。

For example, a ground works contractor, a plumber, a heat pump installer and an electrician. It was obvious that a supervisor should be appointed to oversee and be responsible for the whole installation.
题目中的 "coordinate" 对应录音中的 "oversee and be responsible"；不要填具体的工人名称（如 plumber），要填管理者的角色。
录音最后建议，由于涉及工种繁多，应该任命一名“主管”来统筹和负责整个安装过程。
